description: The extended edition of The Return of the King recut into five sequential chapters, from Sauron's gathering assault through Gondor's war, Mount Doom and the long conclusion of the journey.

s03e01.description: The victory over Isengard gives the Fellowship's scattered survivors little time to recover. A dangerous encounter with the palantír exposes Sauron's attention, Gandalf races toward Minas Tirith, and Frodo, Sam and Gollum edge closer to Mordor under the Eye's growing reach.

s03e02.description: Gondor prepares for siege as Minas Tirith calls for aid and the beacons carry its warning across the mountains. Rohan must choose whether to answer, while Frodo's route toward Mordor narrows and the armies serving Sauron begin closing around the White City.

s03e03.description: With ordinary roads no longer enough, Aragorn accepts the path tied to his ancestry and enters the Paths of the Dead in search of an army bound by an ancient oath. Elsewhere, the march toward Gondor and Frodo's increasingly treacherous approach to Mordor tighten the war on every front.

s03e04.description: Sauron's forces overwhelm the defenses around Minas Tirith and the Battle of the Pelennor Fields becomes the decisive struggle for Gondor. Rohan's charge, the Witch-king's assault and Aragorn's return transform a siege into a vast battle whose cost reaches nearly every surviving member of the Fellowship.

s03e05.description: With the armies of the West making one final diversion at the Black Gate, Frodo and Sam cross the last miles to Mount Doom. The fate of the One Ring, Middle-earth and the long journey from the Shire converge before the survivors face victory, parting and the difficult return home.
